title: Google Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape Google for Jobs listings by search query and location. Returns title, company, location, salary, posted date, job type, description, highlights and apply links. Logged-out public data only.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: What you'd type into Google, e.g. 'data engineer', 'nurse remote'. One search per item.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region or country appended to the search, e.g. 'London, UK' or 'Remote'. Empty = whatever Google infers for the selected country.

countryCode.title: Google country
countryCode.description: Two-letter country for google.<tld> and the proxy location.

languageCode.title: Language (hl)
languageCode.description: Google interface language, e.g. "en", "de", "fr", "en-GB". Filters are phrased in this language (en, de, fr, es supported; others fall back to English).

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Only jobs posted within this window.

maxJobsPerQuery.title: Max jobs per query
maxJobsPerQuery.description: Google shows 10 jobs per search. Beyond 10, the Actor runs refined searches (date windows, job types, seniority) and removes duplicates, so very broad queries reach 50-150 unique jobs; narrow ones may return fewer.

maxJobsTotal.title: Max jobs in total
maxJobsTotal.description: Hard cap across all queries (controls cost). 0 = no cap besides your run's max charge.

includeFullDescription.title: Include full description & all apply links
includeFullDescription.description: Include the job description and job highlights (qualifications, responsibilities, benefits). Google ships these with the listing, so there is no extra charge.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only jobs not returned by my previous runs
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Perfect for daily job alerts. Dedupe by Google job ID + title/company hash.

dedupeKey.title: Dedupe key
dedupeKey.description: Separate dedupe memories for different alert schedules.
